title: Catch {{name}}
holdManual: Drag to aim. Keep your finger down to hold.

status.aiming: Line up the crosshair with the satellite
status.notUp: This pass isn't visible right now
status.waiting: Appears {{countdown}}. Get your bearings in the meantime.

calibrate: Your compass needs calibrating. Move your phone in a figure of eight.

camera.denied: Camera access is off for Overhead. Turn it on in Settings to see the sky behind the crosshair.

moon.label: Moon
moon.instructions: Put the Moon in the crosshair, then tap Set.
moon.down: Calibration needs the Moon, which is below the horizon.
moon.tooFar: That’s more than 45° from the Moon. Check the Moon is in the crosshair and try again.
